basic_info.description: Back on the Market (No fault of the property)  your chance is back! | Perched on prestigious Telegraph Hill, this exquisitely reimagined two-unit building presents a rare opportunity to own a luxurious piece of San Francisco with exceptional future potential. Both residenceseach offering 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and two thoughtfully designed levelshave been meticulously renovated down to the studs, blending modern sophistication with enduring architectural charm. Expansive open floorplans, soaring ceilings, and outdoor spaces on each level create a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The upper unit, 1349 Kearny, boasts a private view terrace with iconic vistas stretching from Saints Peter and Paul Church to the Golden Gate Bridge and the glistening Bay, while the lower unit, 1347 Kearny, showcases 10-ft ceilings and refined finishes. A rooftop deck, primed for completion, offers 360-degree views from Coit Tower to the Transamerica Pyramid, perfect for entertaining or future value enhancement. Just steps from North Beach's legendary dining and culture, great potential for condo conversion, luxury rental, or multi-generational living. Plenty of leased parking just steps away, a truly singular opportunity in one of the city's most storied locations.
